headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.flatWordWalk_law
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : DecidableEq X] {B : ℕ} (step : X → (Fin B → Bool) → X) (start : X)
  (T : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.flatWordWalk step start T) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.walkLaw
      (fun x => OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw (step x)) start
      T

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.joinedWalkWord_law
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit T : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.joinedWalkWord r c U L hr hc start N hIn J hExit T) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.walkLaw
      (fun d => Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit) start T

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.scheduledJoinedWalkWord_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    7 ≤ L →
      ∀
        (hp :
          2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
        (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (t T : ℕ),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
              (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.joinedWalkWord r c U L hr hc start (t + 2) (t + 2)
                (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.attempts OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t)
                (Math115.PhysicalStarBudget.precision OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance t) T))
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.walkLaw (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.idealJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc hp)
              start T) ≤
          ↑T * Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic t
